instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: PackHarbor Pickup Check covers pickup preparation through acknowledgement. The Reservation Clerk creates a pickup record with the rental reference and scheduled item, the Equipment Packer records accessories as packed, and the Readiness Inspector records readiness with an inspection note. The Handover Clerk releases and records the handover only after readiness and packing conditions are met, and the pickup record closes after the Renter acknowledges collection. Payment collection and return inspection are excluded.

output.summary: PackHarbor Pickup Check manages rental pickup preparation through collection acknowledgement. It records the pickup reference and item, accessory packing, readiness and inspection notes, conditional release, handover, acknowledgement, and closure; payment collection and return inspection are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Manage rental pickup preparation through collection acknowledgement.
key_capabilities: Create a pickup record with the rental reference and scheduled item.
Record readiness and an inspection note.
Record collection acknowledgement and close the pickup record.
